focus: Chasing semiconductor export controls, security incidents involving Chinese AI models, and market fallout for our builder and investor audience.

priorities.why: Nvidia halting chip shipments to Southeast Asia marks a major escalation in US export controls.
Security researcher flags unauthorized access to Chinese AI firm MiniMax data, compounding recent app store removals.
Microsoft reports state-backed hackers in China and North Korea incorporating AI pentesting tools.
Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei publicly critiques handing political power to machines amid policy debates.
Australian fund profits by shorting Nvidia during leadership and market turbulence.
